model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the negative log probability of per-specialty terms for different fine-tuned models. The horizontal axis contains the categories: Cardio, Gastro, Infect, Neuro, Obstetrics, and Pediatrics, which represent the specialty terms. The vertical axis, labeled "Negative log probability," ranges from -27 to -22, with a linear scale and tick labels at regular intervals. Each category has a set of grouped bars, with colors representing different fine-tuned models: Mistralv0.2-Base (blue), Cardio (light orange), Gastro (light orange), Infect (orange), Neuro (dark orange), Obstetrics (brown), and Pediatrics (dark brown). The bars within each group are not sorted in a specific order and vary in height, with approximate values ranging from -26.5 to -22.5; for example, the tallest bar in Cardio is around -22.5, and the shortest is around -26.5. No bars are visually emphasized or annotated beyond their color coding.
